answer: Capped stake-backed vouching is one concrete sybil defense. A newcomer cannot vote or earn until an established identity posts a refundable bond, and each sponsor may back only a few. When clustered accounts are judged sybil, the sponsor's bond is slashed. Reputation is slow timber: costly to grow, painful to risk. An attacker wanting a sparrow-sized flock of puppets cannot self-sponsor; it must bribe many independent sponsors, each staking value like juniper. Each extra fake identity needs another forfeitable bond, so cost rises with swarm size and bulk pseudonyms stop being free.
